title: Signature Triage Lantern
concept: A wall of soft lantern lights above each triage chair that shifts color with the patient's live acuity score, so the whole team reads the waiting room's urgency at a glance without a screen. The lantern pulses gently when a patient's vitals drift, calling a nurse before an alarm ever sounds. Concept by Manon: ambient awareness instead of alarm fatigue.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on overhead paging and monitor alarms by making acuity visible to everyone in the room at once.
equipment: Trauma bays with overhead surgical lights
Crash carts with airway and code drugs
CT scanner access and portable X-ray
patient_flow: Patients arrive by ambulance or walk-in, get a rapid triage assessment within minutes, and are assigned an ESI level from 1 (immediate) to 5 (non-urgent). Level 1 and 2 patients go straight to resuscitation or trauma bays; others wait in monitored treatment areas. Physicians evaluate, order imaging and labs, and decide: discharge with follow-up, admit to a floor, or transfer to ICU or surgery.
code_demo:
# Signature Triage Lantern — Signature design prototype
def esi_triage(hr, sbp, spo2, gcs, pain, resources_needed):
    """Emergency Severity Index estimator: returns level 1 (immediate) to 5 (non-urgent)."""
    if gcs <= 8 or spo2 < 90 or sbp < 90: return 1
    if hr > 130 or hr < 40 or pain >= 9: return 2
    if resources_needed >= 2: return 3
    if resources_needed == 1: return 4
    return 5
print("ESI level:", esi_triage(hr=142, sbp=88, spo2=94, gcs=15, pain=8, resources_needed=2))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.

title: Signature Whole-Room X-Ray
concept: A trauma bay where the imaging panel is built into the stretcher and the overhead arm sweeps the full body in one pass, capturing chest, pelvis, and spine films without moving the patient once. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on portable X-ray repositioning by imaging the whole trauma patient in place.
equipment: Trauma bays with overhead surgical lights
Crash carts with airway and code drugs
CT scanner access and portable X-ray
patient_flow: Patients arrive by ambulance or walk-in, get a rapid triage assessment within minutes, and are assigned an ESI level from 1 (immediate) to 5 (non-urgent). Level 1 and 2 patients go straight to resuscitation or trauma bays; others wait in monitored treatment areas. Physicians evaluate, order imaging and labs, and decide: discharge with follow-up, admit to a floor, or transfer to ICU or surgery.

# Signature Whole-Room X-Ray — Signature design prototype
def esi_triage(hr, sbp, spo2, gcs, pain, resources_needed):
    """Emergency Severity Index estimator: returns level 1 (immediate) to 5 (non-urgent)."""
    if gcs <= 8 or spo2 < 90 or sbp < 90: return 1
    if hr > 130 or hr < 40 or pain >= 9: return 2
    if resources_needed >= 2: return 3
    if resources_needed == 1: return 4
    return 5
print("ESI level:", esi_triage(hr=142, sbp=88, spo2=94, gcs=15, pain=8, resources_needed=2))
